changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Record the platform user id of whoever raised a payment voucher, next to the verified_by id the voucher already stores. Verification is the second pair of eyes on money paid out, so it has to come from someone other than whoever raised the voucher, and until now there was nothing on the row to compare a verifier against: created_by holds the auditing string, not a user id, and the two cannot be matched. Vouchers written before this column exists keep a null here and are verified without the comparison, which the self-approval rule logs rather than passing silently.
